name: AccordionRow
description: Piqueray AccordionRow, v2 (2026-09-07) : anchored on the candidate set 2767:20198 (page 031, cloned from the DS set 2059:1417 and reworked with the owner). MAJOR: the anchors leave the v1 set. What changes against 1.2.0: the title WRAPS (no fixed height on title / Titre / TitreOuvert any more), the Grand title is the DS H4 role and the Petit title / the content ride the body role — both vary per viewport through tokens, never through a variant; the chevrons are the governed icons painted noir-bleute; the Grand rule is bound to noir-bleute (was raw #000000). Native button, toggle and ARIA semantics stay deferred to the separately proven semantic-wrapper capability. Named deviations against the dump are carried on each part's description.

props.name: etat
props.description: Controlled when supplied; otherwise toggles independently between fermé and ouvert.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Activates the transparent native trigger projected over the Figma title row.

root.description: Row 1550 wide on the set (FIXED width bound to size.accordion-row.root) — a set member cannot be FILL, so 1550 is a witness: the root is width fill with referenceWidth 1550, the max-width the extraction proposed is dropped. Bottom rule border-width.1; Grand rule bound to color.noir-bleute (dump: stroke var color/noir-bleute), Petit rule stays the raw #26282c at 32 % the set draws (owner decision 2026-09-07: no opacity variable exists, governed literal as in 1.2.0 — the extraction reports it UNBOUND, expected). Padding-block space.16 (Grand) / space.8 (Petit); gap space.24 everywhere except Petit+Ouvert = space.8, as drawn. Dump v1.8 does not record layoutPositioning: the trigger is carried as the absolute overlay it is on the canvas (constraints STRETCH), see its description.

title.description: Open-state title row: FILL width (dump fillWidth), HUG height — 1.2.0 pinned it to size.accordion-row.title (32px), which is what kept the title from wrapping; the chevron is centred on the wrapped title's height, as the candidate draws it (owner decision 2026-09-07, alternative 'top of first line' rejected).

TitreOuvert.description: DEVIATION (named): on the canvas this is a frame `TitreOuvert` (FILL/HUG) holding the text node `Question` (FILL width, HEIGHT auto). The frame is flattened into this single text part (grow = the frame's FILL) so the Odoo DOM (`data-pqr-part="titre"`, one element for both states) keeps working — prior art: ds.accordion-item `titleText` in the demo archive. The extraction cannot read the text's variable bindings (dump v1.8 flattens fontSize/lineHeight to numbers): bound BY HAND on owner decision — Grand = DS role H4 (typography.h4.*, 20/25 then 24/30 per viewport, Medium), Petit = body role (typography.body.size/line-height, 16/24 then 18/27) in Bold (font.weight.bold, 700; no body text style exists on the Figma side, the node is bound directly to the variables, on purpose). letter-spacing 0 is the literal it was in 1.2.0, not a token.

ChevronUp.description: Governed icon chevron-up (registry identity, instance of ChevronUp 226:374 on the candidate — no more raw vector). 32 in Grand, 24 in Petit (size.accordion-row.chevron-up-petit). Painted color.noir-bleute (owner decision 2026-09-07; the dump does not carry the instance's fill, the binding is stated here).

Contenu.description: Open content: FILL width, height AUTO (016: a fixed height clipped real content). Body role for size/line-height (typography.body.size / line-height, 16/24 then 18/27 per viewport), weight REGULAR everywhere (font.weight.regular) — owner decision 2026-09-07: NOT bound to typography.body.weight, which goes Medium above 992. Bound by hand (dump v1.8 flattens text bindings). letter-spacing 0 literal as in 1.2.0.

Titre.description: Closed-state title. Same named DEVIATION as TitreOuvert: the canvas frame `Titre` (FILL/HUG) holding the text `Question` (FILL, HEIGHT auto — the extraction renamed it TitreQuestion) is flattened into this text part, grow = the frame's FILL, so a long question wraps instead of overflowing (the v1 defect n°3). Typography identical to TitreOuvert, bound by hand to the H4 / body roles on owner decision. No fixed height any more (1.2.0: size.accordion-row.titre / titre-petit).

ChevronDown.description: Governed icon chevron-down (registry identity, instance of ChevronDown 226:373 on the candidate — no more raw vector). 32 in Grand, 24 in Petit (size.accordion-row.chevron-down-petit). Painted color.noir-bleute (owner decision 2026-09-07; the dump does not carry the instance's fill, the binding is stated here).

trigger.description: Code-only native disclosure trigger; absolutely overlaid so it contributes no Figma layout geometry (on the candidate: absolute, constraints STRETCH so it follows the row width — the 1550 the extraction proposed as a token is the set witness, dropped). Height size.accordion-row.trigger (32) / trigger-petit (24), unchanged from 1.2.0. KNOWN LIMIT (named 2026-09-07): now that the title wraps, this fixed-height overlay only covers the FIRST line of a wrapped title; the rest of the title is not a hit area. Deciding whether the trigger should cover the whole title row belongs to the contract (not the canvas) and is left to the owner.
